messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads up — hydra-14b-ptq canary is showing flaky summaries. QA samples drop entire middle sentences, sometimes repeat the final sentence. Also spikes in burst latency when batch_size > 4. Repro steps incoming.

Devin Park: Oof. Can you paste one of the bad inputs + outputs? :eyes:

Maya Chen: here's a minimal repro (input shortened):
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the following article in 3 bullet points:\n[long article... about climate policy]\n"
```
OUTPUT (hydra-14b-ptq):
- "Governments updated targets in 2030."\n- "Investment surged in renewable energy."\n- "The report concludes with a call to action."\n"The report concludes with a call to action."  <-- duplicated line, and paragraph break lost

OUTPUT (hydra-14b-fp16): looks correct, no duplication, intact paragraph.

qa-bot: regression-checker failed 7/20 tests for summarize-suite v2 on hydra-14b-ptq. avg ROUGE drop: -3.4. latency p95 batch8 = 1.8s (fp16 p95 batch8 = 1.1s)

Claire Gomez: this smells like quant aliasing in attention or kv cache alignment when batching. Two quick things: run with fused_attn disabled, and try per-channel quantization (vs per-tensor). Also compare outputs with kv_cache disabled to see if repeats are from cache reuse.

Devin Park: infra-bot — what hosts is the canary on and which version? @infra-bot

infra-bot: deploy-notice: hydra-14b-ptq v1.3 deployed to canary set [us-west2-{1..3}], instances: rtx6000-pool-3, rollout at 12% traffic. Canary created 3364999800.

Leo Alvarez: if it's reproducible locally, run:
```
redwoodctl infer --model hydra-14b-ptq --prompt-file samples.json --batch-size 8 --max-new-tokens 256 --disable-fused-attn
```
and check whether the duplication disappears with --batch-size 1.

Maya Chen: starting repro matrix now (batch sizes 1,2,4,8; fused_attn on/off; kv_cache on/off). Will post diff + logs. Also saving failing prompts to s3://redwood-ml/hydra14b/ptq-fails/3365000000.json

Claire Gomez: Also try quick eval with quant flags toggled:
```
eval-run --model hydra-14b-ptq --quant-mode per_channel --symmetrize True --dataset summarize-suite-v2 --out debug/hydra14b-ptq-qflags.log
```
If per_channel reduces ROUGE drop, we likely need to flip quant config or regenerate scale params.

Devin Park: OK if this is customer-impacting roll back to hydra-14b-fp16 canary and scale down ptq. Who can do that?

Leo Alvarez: I can trigger rollback in ~10m if we don't have a hot fix. Will post deploy link.

Maya Chen: Action items:
- Devin: rollback if customer-facing (Triage now)
- Claire: triage quant config + run qflag eval
- Maya: collect repro logs and failing prompts
- Leo: ready to rollback + collect canary traffic traces

Devin Park: on it. tagging #oncall-eng to keep SRE aware. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: thanks — will update thread with results.
